episodes.title: #180: Davey Jackson - Happy Shiny People Cult: Growing Up Under Curriculum & Control
episodes.description:
In this episode, I'm joined by comedian Davey Jackson. Davey shares what it was like to grow up in the Institute of Basic Life Principles (IBLP); better known as the Shiny Happy People Cult, what ideas the IBLP and their leader Bill Gothard sold to millions around the world through bogus seminars, why homeschooling was required in the cult, what coercive control tactics were used on members, how he was sent to a special boys program at 16 for having a girlfriend, what it was like to leave while still living at home with family in the cult, what deprogramming looked like, and how his upbringing influenced his views on authority and gender roles. 

Plus, we get into the difference between misogyny and natural skills, why people today feel so androgynous, why addiction caused him more dysfunction than the cult, what he's learned working on a documentary about a readily available destructive substance, and much more.

episodes.title: #175: Amanda Rae - Escaping A Cult: Polygamy, Fraud, & Siblings Marrying Each Other
episodes.description:
Amanda Rae Grant joins me to share what it was like to escape the Kingston Clan; a polygamous cult in Utah, known as the mafia of polygamists for their involvement in tax fraud, child labor, and incest. 

She shares the connection between them and FLDS cults like Warren Jeffs, how they justify incest and test member's blood to marry them, when she started to realize she was in a cult, how she deprogrammed and escaped, how it led to a disastrous marriage, why women are often the victims in cults, the brainwashing tactics used by cult leaders, what it was like to adjust to life after escaping, how it shaped her beliefs, the hardest part of leaving, and much more.
